correctness.rationale: The graph is connected, not the quandle: each two-point fiber is an inner orbit because every vertex has a neighbor and a right translation preserves the first vertex. Expanding a binary 2-cochain in the basis 1,a,b,ab, the coefficient of the third input bit in the cocycle equation is Aij w_ik, so a neighbor of i kills each mixed coefficient. The remaining equation is Aij p_ik+Aik p_ij+Ajk v_ij=0. Swapping j and k gives equality of v_ij and v_ik on graph edges, so connectedness forces a row constant t_i. The equation with j=i and k adjacent to i gives p_ii=t_i, exactly the remaining diagonal normalization apart from u_ii=0. For a fixed row α of A, the equation is t_i A=αpᵀ+pαᵀ. At t_i=0 evaluating at a coordinate h with α_h=1 makes p a multiple of α. A nonzero solution at t_i=1 requires rank two, since A is nonzero alternating of even rank. Conversely at rank two, take p to be row h: rows i,h are independent, and evaluating an arbitrary row j in their span at h and i forces its two coefficients to be p_j and α_j respectively. This proves the matrix identity, with one independent extra parameter in each row. There are n(n−1) free off-diagonal constants, and each row contributes exactly one coboundary direction d_i Aij because the row is nonzero. The dimensions after subtraction are therefore as stated. A rank-two alternating outer-product representation labels all vertices by nonzero binary vectors of length two; adjacency is distinctness of labels, so there are two or three parts. Conversely two or three nonempty parts can be assigned distinct nonzero labels, producing rank at most two and, by nonzero alternating rank, exactly two. This does not include complete multipartite graphs with more than three parts. Reviewed RESULT.md, VERIFICATION.md and verify_graph_quandle_h2.py as text. The 60 reported cochain systems were not rerun and are not a substitute for the proof.

evidence: The orbit-count rank formula for racks uses invertibility of the order of the finite quotient acting on the rack. Here the inner group is a binary row span of flips of order 2^rank(A), so that condition fails. Corollary 5.4 does apply to unnormalized rack H² and reduces it to H¹ of the structure group with a function module. The García Iglesias–Vendramin theorem assumes indecomposability, which these n-orbit quandles lack. The weighted graph classification does not evaluate the stated group.
broader_coverage.reasoning: An unevaluated structure-group reduction is usable background but does not give the rank-dependent dimension by substituting n; it needs the stabilizer abelianizations and the normalization. The invertible-order formula cannot supply them in characteristic two.

residual_risks: The exact applicability of Lebed–Mortier, Journal of Pure and Applied Algebra 225 (2021), 106474, was not checked in primary full text. This and other broader results for disconnected abelian quandles leave a priority risk.

value.rationale: This computes a natural cohomological invariant for every graph in a motivated family, in the characteristic in which the orbit-count method fails. The exact jump distinguishes graph quandles with the same cardinality and orbit lengths, for instance the four-vertex star and path. Identifying the jump with complete bi- or tripartite structure gives a transparent graph interpretation beyond a few small cochain computations.
